name: Kurla & Kohinoor City
title: Office interiors in Kurla and Kohinoor City
intro: Kohinoor City in Kurla is where we have built more offices than anywhere else, for Visible Alpha, Essel Group, Hansa Cequity, Wincor Nixdorf, Practo, Laerdal and Edelweiss.

points.title: Built here before
points.text: Offices for seven companies in Kohinoor City alone, from 5,500 to 10,000 sq ft.

points.title: Close to our studio
points.text: Our Bhandup West and Powai offices are a short drive away, so site visits are quick.

points.title: One contract
points.text: Design, civil work, joinery, electrical and finishes under one team.
